<!-- pr-reviewer: 8269282e7831c4943113c820e985bb7c09183ed0 -->
**Needs changes before merge** (one wrong step in the guide).

Docs-only; not built (nothing to build).

**What looks good**
- Labels checked against upstream main (`crates/ui/src`): File > Model (Ctrl+O), Setup ribbon group (Setups/Stock/Origin), Stock page Units (Millimeters/Inches), "Use as fixture" / "Stop using as fixture", Fixtures node entries ("Import fixture…", "Save fixture to library…", "Insert from library…"), "Locate part…", "Apply locate", "Locate in fixture", "Align WCS (3-2-1)" (disabled until aligned) all exist as written. The fixture-is-not-machined refusal exists (`crates/app/src/commands/operation/gates.rs:37`).
- Unmerged work (#802 vises, #819 plate grid) is described as not yet available.
- Clean-room: no vendor names or dimensions in either file (grepped for Saunders, SMW, 770, XL); the PR body table uses generic names.
- `Changelog: none` and `Fixes #790` present; decision file is in `docs/decisions/` as the law asks.

**Requested before merge**
1. `docs/user-guide/vendor-fixtures.md`, section 2 "Orient it to sit on the table": **Setup > Origin** is the WCS page (`crates/ui/src/egui_app/pages.rs:521-553`, `wcs_page`). Its **Turn X+ ... Z-** buttons and **Level** rotate/reset the setup's work coordinate system, not the model, and **Align WCS (3-2-1)** likewise aligns the WCS. The text says the buttons "rotate the model" and step 3 treats the result as the model's orientation, which would mislead a user into tilting the WCS instead of the fixture. The buttons that turn the model are on the **Model page** (select the model in the browser tree; `pages.rs:1656-1720`, `turn_model`), which has its own Tilt/Turn fields and **Turn X+ ...** buttons. Rewrite step 1 to use the Model page, and either drop the Level / Align WCS sentences or say they act on the WCS (and what that means for a fixture).

**Notes (not blocking)**
- Placement: `docs/user-guide/` is new, and the docs site in #777 (open) uses `site/content/`. A move into the site is a file move plus a link once #777 lands, as the decision file says; fine for now.
- The guide's steps were checked against the source, not clicked; the correction above shows why a quick click-through of section 2 is worth doing before the re-push.
- Statement that STEP inch files are "scaled to mm" is backed by the PR's own import check; I did not re-verify it in code.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.

<!-- pr-reviewer: 068b66ffef62fd4a4cf3cf1e563be80de535f74f -->
**Ready for the maintainer to merge** (delta review 8269282e..068b66ff, docs only, not built).

The earlier blocker is fixed: section 2 of `docs/user-guide/vendor-fixtures.md` now sends users to the Model page.

Checked against main:
- Labels match `model_page` in `crates/ui/src/egui_app/pages.rs` (~1653-1720): "Turn X+" through "Turn Z-", "Tilt about X (roll)", "Tilt about Y (pitch)", "Turn about Z (yaw)", X/Y/Z and "Apply".
- Selecting a model in the browser tree sets `UiTarget::Model`, which renders `model_page` (`browser_pane.rs:157`, `pages.rs:151`).
- "Every change is one undo step" holds. `turn_model` and Apply both queue `CommandKind::MoveModel` (`pages.rs:676-701`), and `MoveModel` implements `Command` with `invert` (`commands/move_model.rs:264-274`).
- The WCS caveat is accurate. The Setup > Origin turns call `turn_wcs`, which queues `SetWcs` and moves the work coordinate system. "Align WCS (3-2-1)" is in `geo_page.rs`.

No blockers.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.
